preflight.text:
This archive is a collection of internal operational records for Meridian Labs, covering workspace folder conventions, permissions and access rules, approvals workflow, correspondence norms, tooling usage notes and backup schedules. Each entry is a short clause or section with a reference number and a routine review note, and none of them contain confidential content.

The two most frequent document types were:
1. Operations Manual entries (workspace folders and handover filing)
2. Permissions guide entries (access requests and the protected areas)
